about_the_game:
Experience the chaos of Burger Takeout, a co-op roguelike simulator! Each day, orders need to be prepared faster, and more customers arrive. Earn money, upgrade your restaurant, and buy items that help or hinder you at different stages. Spend wisely and use perks strategically—they can save you or make things worse! Experiment with tactics to survive in this ruthless business, where every mistake could cost you everything.

Customize and Evolve Your Restaurant

Each style has unique themes and special items, both decorative and interactive. Purchasing them raises your style level, unlocking new buffs and debuffs. Depending on the game stage, every item can have different effects—so choose wisely!

Changing Weather & Time of Day

Weather affects gameplay in various ways—guests moods, tips, and restaurant cleanliness all change depending on conditions. Time of day and weather also alter the environment, making the world feel more immersive.

Random Events

Earthquakes, zero gravity, and slippery floors shake up gameplay. These events appear for a limited time and can disrupt or even benefit your workflow, depending on your strategy!

Fight Off Pests

Cockroaches appear in unsanitary conditions, multiplying rapidly and swarming the restaurant. They scare guests and lower ratings. Rats steal food, so stay alert and keep an eye on the floor. You can fight pests yourself or call a disinfection service—if you can afford it!

Serve Your Guests

Grill, assemble, and serve quickly—slow service can lead to failure! The faster you work, the more money you make, the higher your rating, and the better the chance of boosting customer mood. The pace increases every day, so efficient teamwork is key!

Dive Into The Dynamic Gameplay

  • Upgrade your restaurant by purchasing new items and themes, increasing your chances of success.

  • Choose restaurant perks wisely and use player perks to gain an advantage.

  • Manage resources and expenses—run out of money, and you won’t be able to buy ingredients, ending the game.

  • Overcome challenges: pests, fires, and kitchen messes will keep you on edge.

  • Adapt to unexpected events that can change the course of the game.

  • Experience two game modes: Career for progression and challenges, or Sandbox for creativity and freedom.

short_description: Burger Takeout – a cooperative roguelike fast-food sim for 1 to 8 players! Manage orders, inventory, and finances while adapting to the market. Raise your rating, optimize resources, and master teamwork to survive the chaos. Use perks and creative strategies to run your kitchen your way!
